summary: Review prototype: server-owned practice attempts and receipts, automatic idempotent XP, controlled recent-sign-in transfers without penalties, assigned-section academic access, credential-free teaching projections and immutable metadata-preparation audits. Not a guarantee or proof of identity; rollout requires exact-head validation.

findings.issue: A random browser key is resettable/copyable. Correct predictions and reflections do not establish who answered, independent authorship or successful runtime execution.
findings.recommendation: Allow shared devices, treat handovers neutrally, keep high-stakes school grades separate, and retain teacher verification of assessment evidence.

findings.issue: Instance bounds, expiring attempts and twelve new examples per minute reduce abuse but do not eliminate bots, collusion or provider costs. App Check is not enforced.
findings.recommendation: Configure and validate App Check and billing alerts separately before broader onboarding. Deploy matching TTL policies and verify index readiness.

findings.issue: Existing records need reviewed scope preparation and explicit staff assignments. Some unrelated legacy sharing policies remain outside this academic-access rewrite.
findings.recommendation: Apply only an approved audited preparation plan with version guards, preserve score/evidence fields, and do not claim full cross-institution isolation.

findings.issue: Class documents contain opaque record identifiers. A capped 500-row display does not establish global rank.
findings.recommendation: Keep the partial-list warning and class-only rules; aliases are pseudonyms rather than anonymity.
